name: Database Schema Design
description: Designs and implements database models with TypeScript types and Zod validation schemas. Used when creating new entities, relationships, or modifying existing data models.
outputPattern: TypeScript model file at src/models/{Name}.ts with Zod schema
systemPromptAddition:
## Database Schema Skill
- Use TypeScript strict mode
- Define interface for the data shape
- Create a Zod schema for runtime validation
- Export both the type and schema
- Include indexes and relationships as comments
- Follow existing model patterns in src/models/
